pr.title: fix(brand): danger reads red across all themes + brand_lint hue invariant
pr.body:
Follow-up to the merged CLI palette cutover (PR #803). Two opt-in themes still routed danger-semantic slots (error / chip.blocker / severity.critical) to magenta/pink, contradicting BRAND_SYSTEM.md §6 ("Red means failed, blocked, or urgent operator action required" and "Hot magenta ... Never used as a status indicator").

GAP 1 (brand-approved: recolor to red-family): pastel-neon-dreamscape danger slots #FF00FF -> #FF0044 (hue 344 deg); pastel-neon-dreams danger slots #FF69B4 -> #FF4D6D (hue 349 deg). Non-semantic magenta/gremlin.pink/bar.pulse accents untouched.

GAP 2: brand_lint.py now asserts, for every theme returned by build_theme(), that error/chip.blocker/severity.critical resolve to a red-family hue (>=340 deg or <=15 deg), so this class of regression is caught by the gate.

steps.task: In src/dopemux/ui/theme.py build_theme(), change the three danger-semantic slots (error, chip.blocker, severity.critical) of pastel-neon-dreamscape from #FF00FF to #FF0044 and of pastel-neon-dreams from #FF69B4 to #FF4D6D. Do not touch magenta, gremlin.pink, bar.pulse, or the _PALETTES accent map.
requirements: Exactly six string-literal edits, all inside build_theme().
Accent slots magenta/gremlin.pink/bar.pulse and _PALETTES remain magenta.

steps.task: Add _iter_theme_danger_hue_violations() to scripts/brand_lint.py: load build_theme + _PALETTES from src/dopemux/ui/theme.py, and for each theme assert error/chip.blocker/severity.critical resolve to a red-family hue (>=340 deg or <=15 deg). Wire it into main().
requirements: Check covers every theme key in _PALETTES.
Fails closed with a clear message when rich/theme import is unavailable.
Magenta (300 deg) and pink (330 deg) are reported as violations.

steps.task: Extend tests/unit/test_brand_lint.py: (a) assert the pure _is_red_family() predicate fails at the magenta/pink/out-of-band boundaries (300, 330, 339, 16) and passes at the in-band boundaries (340, 344, 346, 349, 0, 15); (b) assert _iter_theme_danger_hue_violations() returns [] on current repo state.
requirements: Boundary coverage proves the helper catches non-red danger slots (no fragile monkeypatching of a file-loaded module).
Integration assertion passes on current (recolored) repo state.
validation: uv run --frozen python -m pytest tests/unit/test_brand_lint.py tests/test_ui_splash.py tests/unit/test_dashboard_operator_ui.py -q
